# Julien Simon - AI Operating Partner

> Julien Simon is an AI Operating Partner at Fortino Capital with 30+ years of technology leadership. Expert in Small Language Models, enterprise AI implementation, and bridging AI research with practical business applications. #1 AI Evangelist globally (AI Magazine 2021). 691+ speaking engagements across 37 countries, 564K+ YouTube subscribers, 498+ technical articles. Author of "Learn Amazon SageMaker" (Packt Publishing). Previously VP & Chief Evangelist at Arcee AI, Chief Evangelist at Hugging Face, and Global Evangelist for AI/ML at AWS.

Last updated: 2026-10-04

## Key Facts

- Current role: AI Operating Partner at Fortino Capital (PE & VC)
- 691+ speaking engagements across 37 countries and 95 cities
- 564K+ YouTube subscribers, 458+ videos
- 498+ technical blog posts across AWS, Hugging Face, Medium, Arcee AI, and Substack
- Author of "Learn Amazon SageMaker" (Packt Publishing, 2 editions)
- #1 AI Evangelist globally (AI Magazine 2021)
- Featured in "The 100 Shaping AI in Europe" (L'Opinion & Oliver Wyman, 2025)
- Arm Ambassador (2025)
- 30+ years technology leadership

## Primary Expertise

- Small Language Models (SLMs) — cost-effective, privacy-first enterprise AI
- Enterprise AI Implementation — practical deployment strategies for production
- Private Equity AI Strategy — portfolio company acceleration
- Cloud Computing — AWS (10 certifications), infrastructure optimization
- Open Source AI — Hugging Face ecosystem, open-weights models
- AI Hardware — inference optimization across CPU, GPU, and AI accelerators

## Blog Categories

- [Industry Perspectives](https://www.julien.org/blog/industry-perspectives/): 100 company-agnostic AI industry analysis articles (2021–present)

Covers EU AI regulation, infrastructure economics, CPU inference, Small Language Models, and AI geopolitics.

## Recent Articles

- **Eight Changes to Transformer Attention, and What Each Costs** (October 2026) — The newest open models from Alibaba, Moonshot, DeepSeek and Z.AI no longer read every earlier token. Eight designs, what each costs, and what to test.
- **An Act of God, With Letterhead** (September 2026) — Oracle reportedly called its power problem an act of God. Its annual report had already listed it.
- **Vent Mauvais** (September 2026) — Verlaine's ill wind carries the leaf where it will. States bought Mistral without a tender; where free choice can be measured, it goes elsewhere.
- **At Least 45 Days** (September 2026) — Almost every model on Bedrock gets six months' notice before it can be pulled. The one Washington just accused gets 45 days, and no stated reason.
